title: Chapter 356 Relics
content:
Chapter 356 Relics

After hearing what the two said, Wang Shuo felt a little more desolate!

He must be promoted to the top general as soon as possible, and Wang Shuo's eyes were firm.

Soon the ramen was served, and the taste was still good. Not only were there chopped green onions, but there was also coriander.

While eating noodles, Wang Shuo was thinking about how to improve his strength later.

At this moment, a rough female voice suddenly sounded behind him.

"Hey, Brother Wang, what a coincidence!"

Wang Shuo's heart trembled, and he turned around and saw that it was the King Kong Barbie Wang Cuilian.

"What a coincidence!"

Wang Cuilian and Swan sat next to Wang Shuo enthusiastically.

"Two big bowls of ramen, no chili, no coriander!"

Wang Cuilian immediately said to the ramen chef. It seemed that this was not the first time they came here to eat noodles.

Swan immediately whispered: "Actually, I want coriander!"

Wang Shuo couldn't help it. It seemed that Swan was often disciplined by Wang Cuilian.

Wang Shuo had fought against monsters with them last time, so he was considered an acquaintance.

Since the last time the two of them didn't think about killing people and stealing treasures, Wang Shuo's perception of them is much better than Song Bo's, but it can't be said that they are close.

"Brother Wang, some time ago, we found a ruin in the wild. Are you interested in exploring it together?" Wang Cuilian whispered to Wang Shuo.

Is this a good thing for me?

Wang Shuo frowned when he heard it, feeling that it was probably a trap.

After slurping a mouthful of noodles, Wang Shuo looked at Wang Cuilian and smiled, "Why didn't you two explore it yourself?"

Wang Cuilian said with some embarrassment: "In fact, we have explored it, but we are not strong enough and returned empty-handed."

"First of all, there is a dark gold boss near the ruins, and there are several gold bosses wandering around. I guess they also want to enter the ruins."

"There may be unknown dangers inside the ruins. With only the two of us, our strength is still too weak."

"In the past few days, we have also invited several people to explore together."

Wang Shuo didn't rush to express his opinion when he heard it.

After the two discussed, if Wang Shuo wanted to go, he could just go to the agreed place to gather three days later.

After returning to his residence, Wang Shuo thought about this matter carefully.

According to Wang Cuilian, they did not invite top generals.

The main reason is that with top generals, the things in the ruins may have nothing to do with them.

Wang Shuo also expressed his understanding.

If you want to practice resources in Yingying Town, you can only go to the arena and the Colosseum.

The risks of these two places are not lower than those in the wild.

In the Colosseum, you have to fight with monsters and you must decide life and death. If you are not forced to, no one is willing to go and fight monsters for others to have fun.

As for the arena, once the Shura Order is lost, there is no way to challenge it.

In comparison, the wild may be better. If you can't beat it, you still have a chance to escape.

This is also the reason why many high-level generals appear in the wild.

After practicing in the residence for most of the day, Wang Shuo felt a little hungry, so he planned to go out for something to eat.

As soon as he walked onto the street, he felt that the crowd was a little restless.

He randomly found someone and asked, "Brother, what happened?"

The man looked at Wang Shuo and didn't want to pay attention, but after walking two steps, he stopped and said, "It's like this, a relic appeared in the wild, and now all the major forces in Yingying Town are organizing people to find out. Songjiang Gang, White Tiger Hall, Treasure Pavilion, Colosseum and other forces are recruiting people in the square. Brother, do you want to go together so that you can take care of each other?"

"Relics?"

Wang Shuo was stunned and murmured, "Could it be?"

"Are you going or not?"

"Uh, you go first! I'll think about it..."

"Tsk, what a waste of expression."

Wang Shuo felt a little irritated. Could it be that this relic was the relic that Wang Cuilian mentioned?
